name: trace-loop
description: Reconstruct an incident timeline from logs + SQL traces, settle it with evidence, DO NOT change code
pattern: evidence gathering (two sources in parallel) -> reconcile
whenToUse: There is an exception/stack trace/error log to interpret; an incident timeline is needed.
whenNotToUse: The root cause is already known -> go straight to fixbug-loop.

steps.exitCriteria: The ring buffers live IN PROCESS MEMORY: an app restart loses them. Gone => say so on the first line, do not keep reasoning.

steps.goal: Determine WHICH request before reading a single line
steps.exitCriteria: Anchored on one id. CANNOT anchor => say plainly that the logs are unfiltered and every correlation after that is SPECULATION.
steps.note: Header X-Correlation-ID, log field CorrelationId. Reading unanchored logs is the fastest way to weld two requests into one story.

steps.goal: Collect evidence from both sources at once
steps.exitCriteria: Quote VERBATIM. Do not summarise the stack trace.
steps.note: The two sources are independent, so run them in parallel; see the triage-incident workflow in HW.Agentic/Workflow/WorkflowCatalog.cs.

steps.goal: Order by TIME, not by severity
steps.exitCriteria: A continuous timeline, or an explicit marker of where it breaks

outputs: List of consequences mistaken for the cause
steps.exitCriteria: Stop at the first line that NOTHING before it explains. The code may only be entered from there.
steps.note: The noisiest error line is almost always the thing that gets fixed by mistake.

steps.goal: Separate the certain part from the guessed part
outputs: Every claim tied to a quotable line
steps.exitCriteria: No sentence blends the certain and the guessed

stopConditions.rule: the ring buffer is gone and there are no logs on disk
stopConditions.action: Stop. Report what is needed to reproduce; do not guess through the dark.
Stop. This loop is read-only. Move to /fixbug with the proven root cause.

handoff.when: the timeline stands up and there is a root cause at file:line
